approach_summary.R1: Introduced SandboxPort + SandboxFactoryPort Protocols in the application layer. ExecutionRouter now accepts a SandboxFactoryPort in its constructor and raises RuntimeError when asked to create a sandbox without one. ProcessSandboxFactory adapter lives in infrastructure/sandbox/sandbox_factory.py and lazily delegates to the existing tools.sandbox.create_sandbox function; production call sites that only use policy_for_tool remain source-compatible. The direct 'from ds_agent.tools.sandbox import ProcessSandbox, create_sandbox' at execution_router.py:9 has been removed, which is the root of the transitive chain lint-imports was flagging.
approach_summary.R3: Added tests/unit/application/conftest.py with an autouse fixture that installs a process-global LineageCaptureService backed by an in-memory LineageStorePort implementation, restoring the previous value on teardown. This satisfies LineageCaptureHook()'s strict dependency during build_hook_registry without weakening the production check and without touching governance_hooks.py, process_subagent.py, or the subagent tests themselves.
